```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#
# DATA SOURCES (both must live in the same folder as this .qmd):
#   fragrances.csv  — your collection catalog (one row per bottle)
#   wear_log.csv    — your wear journal (one row per wear)
#
# To update:
#   1. Edit fragrances.csv and/or wear_log.csv
#   2. Run:  quarto render index.qmd
#   The rebuilt HTML embeds the new data; no JS edits needed.
#
# Pipe-separated list columns: seasons, top_notes, heart_notes, base_notes
#   e.g.  seasons = Fall|Winter      top_notes = Saffron|Rose|Bergamot
#
import csv, json, sys, os

def _list(s):
    if not s or not str(s).strip():
        return []
    return [x.strip() for x in str(s).split('|') if x.strip()]

def _num(s, as_float=False):
    if s is None or not str(s).strip():
        return None
    try:
        return float(s) if as_float else int(float(s))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None

fragrances = []
try:
    with open('fragrances.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
            pyr = {
                'top':   _list(row.get('top_notes',   '')),
                'heart': _list(row.get('heart_notes', '')),
                'base':  _list(row.get('base_notes',  ''))
            }
            f = {'name': row['name'].strip(), 'maker': row['maker'].strip()}
            for field in ['concentration','tier','status','notes_raw','projection',
                          'perfumer','scraped_url','url_status','time','fragram']:
                f[field] = row.get(field, '').strip()
            for field, af in [('longevity_hours', False), ('sillage', False),
                               ('overall_rating',  True),  ('launch_year', False)]:
                f[field] = _num(row.get(field, ''), af)
            f['seasons'] = _list(row.get('seasons', ''))
            f['pyramid'] = pyr
            note = row.get('note', '').strip()
            if note:
                f['note'] = note
            fragrances.append(f)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print('<script>console.error("[SOTD] fragrances.csv not found — '
          'place it next to index.qmd and re-render.");</script>')

print('<script>window.FRAGRANCES = ' +
      json.dumps(fragrances, ensure_ascii=False) + ';</script>')

# ── Wear log: committed rows, handed to JS so history survives a browser wipe ──
wear_log = []
try:
    with open('wear_log.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
            if not (row.get('name') or '').strip():
                continue
            w = {(k or '').strip(): (v or '').strip() for k, v in row.items() if k}
            for fld in ['sprays', 'temp_f', 'longevity_obs_h', 'sillage_obs', 'ts']:
                w[fld] = _num(w.get(fld, ''), False)
            w['rating_today'] = _num(w.get('rating_today', ''), True)
            wear_log.append(w)
except FileNotFoundError:
    pass   # first run: no log yet

print('<script>window.WEAR_LOG = ' +
      json.dumps(wear_log, ensure_ascii=False) + ';</script>')
```

```{=html}
<script type="text/javascript">
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // FRAGRANCES is injected by the Python chunk above at Quarto render time.
  // Edit fragrances.csv, then re-render — no changes needed here.
  const FRAGRANCES = (window.FRAGRANCES && window.FRAGRANCES.length)
    ? window.FRAGRANCES
    : [];

  // ── DOM refs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const cardEl       = document.getElementById('frag-card');
  const metaEl       = document.getElementById('meta-count');
  const historyEl    = document.getElementById('history-list');
  const avoidEl      = document.getElementById('avoid');
  const modeLabel    = document.getElementById('mode-label');
  const seasonChips  = document.querySelectorAll('#season-chips .chip');
  const timeChips    = document.querySelectorAll('#time-chips .chip');
  const searchInput  = document.getElementById('frag-search');
  const searchResults= document.getElementById('search-results');
  const searchClear  = document.getElementById('search-clear');

  // ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const state = { season: new Set(), time: new Set(), avoidRecent: false, current: null };

  // Wear history lives in localStorage — persists across browser sessions.
  let history = [];
  try { history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sotd-history') || '[]'); } catch(e) { history = []; }
  if (!Array.isArray(history)) history = [];

  // ── Weather ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let weatherState = null;
  const DEFAULT_LOC = { name: 'Salem, OR', lat: 44.9429, lon: -123.0351 };
  let savedLoc = DEFAULT_LOC;
  try {
    const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sotd-location') || 'null');
    if (stored && stored.lat && stored.lon && stored.name) savedLoc = stored;
  } catch(e){}

  const WX_CODES = {
    0:{icon:'☀️',lbl:'Clear'},    1:{icon:'🌤️',lbl:'Mainly clear'},
    2:{icon:'⛅',lbl:'Partly cloudy'}, 3:{icon:'☁️',lbl:'Overcast'},
    45:{icon:'🌫️',lbl:'Foggy'},   48:{icon:'🌫️',lbl:'Freezing fog'},
    51:{icon:'🌦️',lbl:'Light drizzle'},53:{icon:'🌦️',lbl:'Drizzle'},
    55:{icon:'🌧️',lbl:'Heavy drizzle'},
    61:{icon:'🌧️',lbl:'Light rain'},63:{icon:'🌧️',lbl:'Rain'},65:{icon:'🌧️',lbl:'Heavy rain'},
    71:{icon:'🌨️',lbl:'Light snow'},73:{icon:'❄️',lbl:'Snow'},75:{icon:'❄️',lbl:'Heavy snow'},
    80:{icon:'🌦️',lbl:'Showers'},  81:{icon:'🌧️',lbl:'Heavy showers'},
    82:{icon:'⛈️',lbl:'Violent showers'}, 95:{icon:'⛈️',lbl:'Thunderstorm'}
  };
  function wxDesc(code){
    if (WX_CODES[code]) return WX_CODES[code];
    if (code<=3)  return {icon:'⛅',lbl:'Cloudy'};
    if (code<=48) return {icon:'🌫️',lbl:'Foggy'};
    if (code<=67) return {icon:'🌧️',lbl:'Rainy'};
    if (code<=77) return {icon:'❄️',lbl:'Snowy'};
    if (code<=82) return {icon:'🌦️',lbl:'Showers'};
    return {icon:'⛈️',lbl:'Stormy'};
  }

  function wxScore(f, wx){
    if (!wx) return 3;
    const temp    = wx.temperature_2m;
    const code    = wx.weathercode;
    const precip  = wx.precipitation || 0;
    const seasons = Array.isArray(f.seasons) ? f.seasons : [];
    const isAll   = seasons.indexOf('All') !== -1;
    let   score   = 3;

    if      (temp >= 82){ score += isAll ? 2 : (seasons.includes('Summer') ? 3 : seasons.includes('Spring') ? 1 : -2); }
    else if (temp >= 65){ score += isAll ? 1 : (seasons.some(s => s==='Spring'||s==='Summer') ? 2 : seasons.includes('Fall') ? 0 : -1); }
    else if (temp >= 50){ score += isAll ? 1 : (seasons.some(s => s==='Spring'||s==='Fall') ? 2 : 0); }
    else if (temp >= 36){ score += isAll ? 1 : (seasons.some(s => s==='Fall'||s==='Winter') ? 2 : seasons.includes('Spring') ? -1 : -2); }
    else                { score += isAll ? 2 : (seasons.includes('Winter') ? 3 : seasons.includes('Fall') ? 1 : -2); }

    const isWet = precip > 0.3 || (code >= 51 && code <= 82);
    if (isWet){ if ((f.sillage||3)<=2) score+=1; else if ((f.sillage||3)>=5) score-=1; }

    return Math.max(1, score);
  }

  function wxHint(wx){
    if (!wx) return '';
    const temp   = wx.temperature_2m;
    const code   = wx.weathercode;
    const precip = wx.precipitation || 0;
    const isWet  = precip > 0.3 || (code >= 51 && code <= 82);
    let h;
    if      (temp >= 82) h = 'warm day — lighter and fresher scents preferred';
    else if (temp >= 65) h = 'comfortable out — spring and summer fragrances shine';
    else if (temp >= 50) h = 'mild weather — versatile picks favored';
    else if (temp >= 36) h = 'cool day — richer, warmer fragrances preferred';
    else                 h = 'cold out — perfect for heavy orientals and leathers';
    if (isWet) h += ' · lighter sillage in the rain';
    return h;
  }

  function renderWeather(wx){
    const bar = document.getElementById('weather-bar');
    if (!bar) return;
    const locInput = '<input id="wx-loc-input" class="wx-loc-input" value="' + esc(savedLoc.name) +
                     '" title="Type a city and press Enter" aria-label="Location">';
    if (!wx){
      bar.classList.remove('loading', 'hidden');
      bar.innerHTML = '📍 ' + locInput;
      wireLocInput(); return;
    }
    const d     = wxDesc(wx.weathercode);
    const hint  = wxHint(wx);
    const tempF = Math.round(wx.temperature_2m);
    bar.classList.remove('loading', 'hidden');
    bar.innerHTML =
      '📍 ' + locInput + ' · ' +
      d.icon +
      ' <span class="wx-temp">' + tempF + '°F</span>' +
      ' <span class="wx-cond">· ' + d.lbl + '</span>' +
      (hint ? ' <span class="wx-hint">· ' + esc(hint) + '</span>' : '');
    wireLocInput();
  }

  function wireLocInput(){
    const inp = document.getElementById('wx-loc-input');
    if (!inp) return;
    inp.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if (e.key === 'Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); geocodeAndFetch(inp.value.trim()); }
      if (e.key === 'Escape'){ inp.value = savedLoc.name; inp.blur(); }
    });
  }

  function fetchWeatherForLoc(loc){
    const url = 'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=' + loc.lat +
                '&longitude=' + loc.lon +
                '&current=temperature_2m,precipitation,weather_code' +
                '&temperature_unit=fahrenheit&timezone=auto';
    fetch(url)
      .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
      .then(function(data){
        const cur = (data && data.current) || null;
        // Open-Meteo renamed `weathercode` -> `weather_code`; accept either so
        // everything downstream can keep reading `weathercode`.
        if (cur && cur.weather_code != null && cur.weathercode == null){
          cur.weathercode = cur.weather_code;
        }
        weatherState = cur;
        renderWeather(weatherState);
        render(pickDaily()); setMode('daily');
      })
      .catch(function(){ renderWeather(null); });
  }

  function geocodeAndFetch(query){
    if (!query) return;
    const bar = document.getElementById('weather-bar');
    if (bar){ bar.classList.add('loading'); bar.textContent = 'Finding ' + query + '…'; }
    const url = 'https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?name=' +
                encodeURIComponent(query) + '&count=1&language=en&format=json';
    fetch(url)
      .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
      .then(function(data){
        const r = data && data.results && data.results[0];
        if (!r){ renderWeather(weatherState); return; }
        savedLoc = {
          name: r.name + (r.admin1 ? ', ' + r.admin1 : ''),
          lat:  r.latitude, lon: r.longitude
        };
        try { localStorage.setItem('sotd-location', JSON.stringify(savedLoc)); } catch(e){}
        fetchWeatherForLoc(savedLoc);
      })
      .catch(function(){ renderWeather(weatherState); });
  }

  // ── Utilities ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function todayKey(){
    const d = new Date();
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
  }
  function dayNumber(){
    const d = new Date();
    return Math.floor((d - new Date(d.getFullYear(), 0, 0)) / 86400000);
  }
  function mulberry32(seed){
    return function(){
      let t = seed += 0x6D2B79F5;
      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  function esc(s){
    if (s == null) return '';
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c){
      return ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'})[c];
    });
  }

  // ── Filtering & selection ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  function seasonMatch(f){
    if (state.season.size === 0) return true;
    const seasons = Array.isArray(f.seasons) ? f.seasons : [];
    if (seasons.indexOf('All') !== -1) return true;
    return seasons.some(function(s){ return state.season.has(s); });
  }
  function timeMatch(f){
    if (state.time.size === 0) return true;
    const t = f.time || 'Flexible';
    if (t === 'Flexible') return true;
    return state.time.has(t);
  }
  function recentNames(days){
    const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86400000;
    const set = new Set();
    history.forEach(function(h){ if ((h.ts || 0) >= cutoff) set.add(h.name); });
    return set;
  }
  function baseCandidates(){
    return FRAGRANCES.filter(function(f){ return seasonMatch(f) && timeMatch(f); });
  }
  function candidates(){
    const base = baseCandidates();
    if (state.avoidRecent){
      const recent = recentNames(7);
      const fresh = base.filter(function(f){ return !recent.has(f.name); });
      if (fresh.length) return fresh;
    }
    return base.length ? base : FRAGRANCES;
  }
  function pickDaily(){
    const list = candidates();
    if (!list.length) return null;
    const rng = mulberry32(new Date().getFullYear() * 1000 + dayNumber());
    if (!weatherState) return list[Math.floor(rng() * list.length)];
    const weights = list.map(f => wxScore(f, weatherState));
    const total   = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    let r = rng() * total;
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
      r -= weights[i];
      if (r <= 0) return list[i];
    }
    return list[list.length - 1];
  }
  function pickRandom(){
    const list = candidates();
    return list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)];
  }

  // ── Rendering ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function stars(r){
    if (r == null) return '';
    const full = Math.round(r);
    let s = '<span class="stars-gold">';
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) s += (i < full) ? '★' : '☆';
    return s + '</span>';
  }
  function dots(n){
    if (n == null) return '';
    let s = '';
    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) s += (i <= n) ? '●' : '○';
    return s;
  }
  function chip(text, cls){
    return '<span class="badge ' + cls + '">' + esc(text) + '</span>';
  }
  const seasonClass = {'Spring':'s-spring','Summer':'s-summer','Fall':'s-fall','Autumn':'s-fall','Winter':'s-winter','All':'s-all'};
  const timeClass   = {'Day':'t-day','Night':'t-night','Flexible':'t-flex'};

  function seasonBadges(seasons){
    if (!Array.isArray(seasons) || !seasons.length) return '';
    return seasons.map(function(s){ return chip(s, seasonClass[s] || 's-all'); }).join('');
  }
  function pyramidHTML(p){
    if (!p) return '';
    const cols = [['top','Top'],['heart','Heart'],['base','Base']];
    let out = '';
    cols.forEach(function(c){
      const notes = p[c[0]];
      if (!Array.isArray(notes) || !notes.length) return;
      let chipsHtml = '';
      notes.forEach(function(n){ chipsHtml += '<span class="note-chip">' + esc(n) + '</span>'; });
      out += '<div class="pyr-col"><div class="pyr-label">' + c[1] + '</div><div class="pyr-notes">' + chipsHtml + '</div></div>';
    });
    return out ? '<div class="pyramid">' + out + '</div>' : '';
  }

  function render(f){
    if (!f){
      cardEl.innerHTML = '<p class="muted">No fragrance matches your filters.</p>';
      state.current = null;
      return;
    }
    state.current = f;
    const ratingTxt = (f.overall_rating != null) ? Number(f.overall_rating).toFixed(1) + ' / 5' : '—';
    const metaParts = [];
    if (f.concentration) metaParts.push(chip(f.concentration, 'meta'));
    if (f.tier)          metaParts.push(chip(f.tier, 'meta'));
    if (f.launch_year)   metaParts.push(chip('Est. ' + f.launch_year, 'meta'));
    if (f.time)          metaParts.push(chip(f.time, timeClass[f.time] || 't-flex'));
    const sb = seasonBadges(f.seasons);
    if (sb) metaParts.push(sb);

    let html = '';
    html += '<div class="frag-head">';
    html += '<div><div class="frag-name">' + esc(f.name) + '</div><div class="frag-maker">' + esc(f.maker) + '</div></div>';
    html += '<div class="frag-img-wrap">';
    if (f.fragram) {
      html += '<img class="frag-img" src="' + esc(f.fragram) + '" alt="' + esc(f.name) + '" loading="lazy"' +
              ' onerror="this.style.display=\'none\'"' +
              ' data-lightbox="' + esc(f.fragram) + '">';
    }
    html += '<div class="frag-rating"><div>' + stars(f.overall_rating) + '</div><div class="rating-num">' + ratingTxt + '</div></div>';
    html += '</div>';
    html += '</div>';

    html += '<div class="frag-meta">' + metaParts.join('') + '</div>';

    html += '<div class="frag-stats">';
    html += '<div class="stat"><span class="stat-icon">⏱️</span><div><strong>' + (f.longevity_hours != null ? f.longevity_hours + ' h' : '—') + '</strong><small>Longevity</small></div></div>';
    html += '<div class="stat"><span class="stat-icon">📢</span><div><strong class="dots">' + (dots(f.sillage) || '—') + '</strong><small>Sillage</small></div></div>';
    html += '<div class="stat"><span class="stat-icon">🌫️</span><div><strong>' + esc(f.projection || '—') + '</strong><small>Projection</small></div></div>';
    html += '</div>';

    if (f.notes_raw) html += '<div class="frag-note">' + esc(f.notes_raw) + '</div>';

    html += pyramidHTML(f.pyramid);

    if (f.perfumer) html += '<div class="frag-perfumer"><span class="lbl">Perfumer</span>' + esc(f.perfumer) + '</div>';

    html += '<div class="wear-panel">';
    html += '<div class="wear-panel-title">Log this wear</div>';
    html += '<div class="wear-fields">';
    html += '<label>Occasion<input id="w-occasion" type="text" placeholder="work, dinner, hike"></label>';
    html += '<label>Sprays<input id="w-sprays" type="number" min="1" max="20" step="1" placeholder="2"></label>';
    html += '<label>Your rating<input id="w-rating" type="number" min="1" max="5" step="0.5" placeholder="4.5"></label>';
    html += '<label>Longevity (h)<input id="w-longevity" type="number" min="0" max="24" step="0.5" placeholder="8"></label>';
    html += '<label>Sillage<input id="w-sillage" type="number" min="1" max="5" step="1" placeholder="4"></label>';
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<label class="wear-notes-label">Observations';
    html += '<textarea id="w-notes" rows="3" placeholder="How did it wear? Projection, drydown, how it moved through the day, compliments…"></textarea>';
    html += '</label>';
    html += '</div>';

    html += '<div class="frag-actions">';
    if (f.scraped_url) html += '<a class="frag-link" href="' + esc(f.scraped_url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View on Fragrantica ↗</a>';
    html += '<button class="frag-wear" type="button">✔ Mark as worn + save notes</button>';
    html += '</div>';

    cardEl.innerHTML = html;
    const wearBtn = cardEl.querySelector('.frag-wear');
    if (wearBtn) wearBtn.addEventListener('click', markWorn);
  }

  function renderChips(){
    seasonChips.forEach(function(c){
      const v = c.dataset.season;
      const active = (v === 'All') ? state.season.size === 0 : state.season.has(v);
      c.classList.toggle('active', active);
    });
    timeChips.forEach(function(c){
      const v = c.dataset.time;
      const active = (v === 'Any') ? state.time.size === 0 : state.time.has(v);
      c.classList.toggle('active', active);
    });
  }
  function updateCount(){
    const base = baseCandidates();
    metaEl.textContent = base.length
      ? base.length + ' of ' + FRAGRANCES.length + ' fragrances match'
      : 'No matches — showing all ' + FRAGRANCES.length;
  }
  function setMode(mode, label){
    const d = new Date();
    const dateStr = d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {weekday:'long', month:'long', day:'numeric'});
    if (label) {
      modeLabel.textContent = label;
    } else {
      modeLabel.textContent = (mode === 'daily') ? "Today's selection · " + dateStr : 'Random pick · ' + dateStr;
    }
  }
  function renderHistory(){
    const recents = history.slice(0, 8);
    const cnt = document.getElementById('log-count');
    if (cnt) cnt.textContent = history.length + ' wear' + (history.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' logged';
    if (!recents.length){
      historyEl.innerHTML = '<span class="muted">Nothing marked as worn yet.</span>';
      return;
    }
    let out = '';
    recents.forEach(function(h){
      const tip = h.notes ? ' title="' + esc(h.notes) + '"' : '';
      const dot = h.notes ? ' 📝' : '';
      out += '<span class="hist-chip"' + tip + '><strong>' + esc(h.name) + '</strong>' + dot +
             '<span class="hist-date">' + esc(h.date) + '</span></span>';
    });
    historyEl.innerHTML = out;
  }

  // ── Wear log ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The journal is a flat file (wear_log.csv) that you commit to the repo.
  // localStorage is only a scratchpad for wears you haven't exported yet.
  function slug(s){
    return String(s || '').toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
  }
  function wearId(date, name, maker){
    return date + '-' + slug(name) + '-' + slug(maker).slice(0, 14);
  }
  function persistHistory(){
    try { localStorage.setItem('sotd-history', JSON.stringify(history)); } catch(e){}
  }
  function readPanel(){
    const g = function(id){
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      return el ? el.value.trim() : '';
    };
    return {
      occasion:        g('w-occasion'),
      sprays:          g('w-sprays'),
      rating_today:    g('w-rating'),
      longevity_obs_h: g('w-longevity'),
      sillage_obs:     g('w-sillage'),
      notes:           g('w-notes')
    };
  }
  function clearPanel(){
    ['w-occasion','w-sprays','w-rating','w-longevity','w-sillage','w-notes']
      .forEach(function(id){
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.value = '';
      });
  }
  function mergeLogs(){
    const seen = {}, out = [];
    function add(h){
      if (!h || !h.name || !h.date) return;
      const id = h.wear_id || wearId(h.date, h.name, h.maker || '');
      if (seen[id]) return;
      seen[id] = true;
      h.wear_id = id;
      out.push(h);
    }
    (window.WEAR_LOG || []).forEach(add);   // committed rows first
    history.forEach(add);                    // browser rows fill the gaps
    out.sort(function(a,b){ return (b.ts || 0) - (a.ts || 0); });
    history = out;
  }
  const WEAR_COLS = ['wear_id','date','name','maker','occasion','sprays','temp_f','weather',
                     'rating_today','longevity_obs_h','sillage_obs','would_rewear','notes','ts'];
  function csvCell(v){
    if (v == null) return '';
    const s = String(v);
    return /[",\n\r]/.test(s) ? '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : s;
  }
  function exportWearLog(){
    const rows = history.slice().sort(function(a,b){
      return (a.date || '').localeCompare(b.date || '') || ((a.ts || 0) - (b.ts || 0));
    });
    const lines = [WEAR_COLS.join(',')];
    rows.forEach(function(h){
      lines.push(WEAR_COLS.map(function(c){ return csvCell(h[c]); }).join(','));
    });
    const blob = new Blob([lines.join('\n') + '\n'], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = 'wear_log.csv';
    a.click();
    setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 1000);
  }

  function markWorn(){
    if (!state.current) return;

    const f     = state.current;
    const today = todayKey();
    const id    = wearId(today, f.name, f.maker);
    const p     = readPanel();
    const wx    = weatherState || {};

    // Replace only THIS fragrance's entry for today.
    // The old code filtered on `date` alone, so wearing a second scent
    // in the same day silently deleted the first one.
    history = history.filter(function(h){ return h.wear_id !== id; });

    history.push({
      wear_id:         id,
      date:            today,
      name:            f.name,
      maker:           f.maker,
      occasion:        p.occasion,
      sprays:          p.sprays,
      temp_f:          (wx.temperature_2m != null) ? Math.round(wx.temperature_2m) : '',
      weather:         (wx.weathercode    != null) ? wxDesc(wx.weathercode).lbl    : '',
      rating_today:    p.rating_today,
      longevity_obs_h: p.longevity_obs_h,
      sillage_obs:     p.sillage_obs,
      would_rewear:    '',
      notes:           p.notes,
      ts:              Date.now()
    });

    history.sort(function(a,b){ return (b.ts || 0) - (a.ts || 0); });
    // NOTE: the old `history = history.slice(0, 50);` cap is intentionally removed.
    // At one row per wear that cap discarded history after ~7 weeks.

    persistHistory();
    renderHistory();
    clearPanel();
  }

  // ── Filter chip events ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  seasonChips.forEach(function(c){
    c.addEventListener('click', function(){
      const v = c.dataset.season;
      if (v === 'All'){ state.season.clear(); }
      else { if (state.season.has(v)) state.season.delete(v); else state.season.add(v); }
      renderChips(); updateCount();
      render(pickDaily()); setMode('daily');
    });
  });
  timeChips.forEach(function(c){
    c.addEventListener('click', function(){
      const v = c.dataset.time;
      if (v === 'Any'){ state.time.clear(); }
      else { if (state.time.has(v)) state.time.delete(v); else state.time.add(v); }
      renderChips(); updateCount();
      render(pickDaily()); setMode('daily');
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('btn-daily').addEventListener('click', function(){ render(pickDaily()); setMode('daily'); });
  document.getElementById('btn-random').addEventListener('click', function(){ render(pickRandom()); setMode('random'); });
  avoidEl.addEventListener('change', function(){ state.avoidRecent = avoidEl.checked; updateCount(); });

  // ── Search ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function buildSearchList(q){
    if (!q){ searchResults.classList.add('hidden'); return; }
    const lq = q.toLowerCase();
    const hits = FRAGRANCES.filter(function(f){
      return f.name.toLowerCase().includes(lq) ||
             (f.maker || '').toLowerCase().includes(lq);
    }).slice(0, 9);

    if (!hits.length){
      searchResults.innerHTML = '<li class="no-match">No matches in your collection</li>';
    } else {
      searchResults.innerHTML = hits.map(function(f){
        return '<li data-name="' + esc(f.name) + '">' +
               '<span class="sr-name">' + esc(f.name) + '</span>' +
               '<span class="sr-maker">' + esc(f.maker) + '</span>' +
               '</li>';
      }).join('');
      searchResults.querySelectorAll('li[data-name]').forEach(function(li){
        li.addEventListener('click', function(){
          const frag = FRAGRANCES.find(function(f){ return f.name === li.dataset.name; });
          if (frag){
            render(frag);
            setMode('search', '🔍 Selected · ' + frag.name);
          }
          searchInput.value = '';
          searchClear.classList.remove('visible');
          searchResults.classList.add('hidden');
        });
      });
    }
    searchResults.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  searchInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
    const q = this.value.trim();
    searchClear.classList.toggle('visible', q.length > 0);
    buildSearchList(q);
  });
  searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.key === 'Escape'){
      searchInput.value = '';
      searchClear.classList.remove('visible');
      searchResults.classList.add('hidden');
    }
  });
  searchClear.addEventListener('click', function(){
    searchInput.value = '';
    searchClear.classList.remove('visible');
    searchResults.classList.add('hidden');
    searchInput.focus();
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if (!e.target.closest('.search-wrap')) searchResults.classList.add('hidden');
  });

  // ── Lightbox ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const lightbox    = document.getElementById('lightbox');
  const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');

  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    const trigger = e.target.closest('[data-lightbox]');
    if (trigger){
      lightboxImg.src = trigger.dataset.lightbox;
      lightboxImg.alt = trigger.alt;
      lightbox.classList.add('open');
      return;
    }
    if (e.target === lightbox || e.target === lightboxImg){
      lightbox.classList.remove('open');
      lightboxImg.src = '';
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { lightbox.classList.remove('open'); lightboxImg.src = ''; }
  });

  // ── Init ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function init(){
    mergeLogs();          // pull in committed wear_log.csv rows FIRST,
                          // so they can influence today's pick and the skip filter
    renderChips();
    updateCount();

    // Latest wear logged today (multiple wears per day are now possible).
    const todayEntry = history
      .filter(function(h){ return h.date === todayKey(); })
      .sort(function(a,b){ return (b.ts || 0) - (a.ts || 0); })[0];

    const f = todayEntry
      ? (FRAGRANCES.find(function(x){ return x.name === todayEntry.name; }) || pickDaily())
      : pickDaily();
    render(f);

    document.getElementById('btn-export-log').addEventListener('click', exportWearLog);
    renderHistory();
    setMode('daily');

    fetchWeatherForLoc(savedLoc);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
```
